title: Izmir Public Services Open Data Snapshot
subtitle: Five geospatial public-service layers with provenance, QA and CC BY 4.0
description:
A reproducible, analysis-ready geospatial snapshot of five public-service layers from the İzmir Metropolitan Municipality Open Data Portal: duty pharmacies, pharmacies, hospitals, street markets, and emergency assembly areas.

The official records are normalized into a common schema and published with provenance, retrieval timestamps, coverage status, machine-readable validation evidence, file descriptions, and field-level documentation.

Useful for geospatial EDA, public-health and urban-service visualization, educational notebooks, open-data engineering, and source-aware proximity experiments.

Responsible-use boundary: this snapshot does not establish walking, driving, transit, accessibility, or emergency-response travel time. Missing source data does not imply service absence. No user location or other personal user data is included.

Project: https://github.com/senih25/15-dakika-izmir
Live application: https://15-dakika-izmir.vercel.app
userSpecifiedSources:
İzmir Büyükşehir Belediyesi Açık Veri Portalı — https://acikveri.bizizmir.com

Official source datasets: duty pharmacies and pharmacies, health institutions, street markets, and emergency assembly areas. Full source URLs and retrieval notes are provided in sources.csv.
